ERREUR_INTERNE: The operation failed unexpectedly. The log of the application gives the type of the failure.
BASE_PLUS_RECENTE: The data file was opened by a newer version of the application ({migration}). Install that version to open it.
MIGRATION_MODIFIEE: The data file does not match this version of the application (update {migration} changed). Restore a backup, or reinstall the version that created it.
SCHEMA_MODIFIE: The structure of the data file was changed outside the application. Restore a backup.
EMPREINTE_ABSENTE: The data file holds an update applied without the application ({migration}). Restore a backup.
BASE_EN_RETARD: The database must be updated: run the application with --migrate.
DROITS_INSUFFISANTS: The account lacks the rights it needs on the folder of the data or on the database (read-only folder or file, or access denied).
BASE_INACCESSIBLE: The data file cannot be opened: it is missing, damaged, or not a file of the application. Restore a backup.
BASE_OCCUPEE: The database is busy with another operation. Try again in a moment.
VERROU_MIGRATIONS: An update of the data file was interrupted and left its lock. Close any other window of the application, then start again; if the message comes back, restore the backup made before the update (advanced user: remove the row of the table __EFMigrationsLock).
FICHIER_SUR_PARTAGE: The data file is on a network share ({place}): SQLite could damage it. Move it to the disk of the workstation; to pass a project on, use the project export.
FICHIER_DOSSIER_SYNCHRONISE: The data file is in a synchronised folder ({place}, OneDrive or SharePoint): the synchronisation could damage it. Move it to a folder of the workstation that is not synchronised.
FICHIER_CHEMIN_NON_PRIS_EN_CHARGE: The path of the data file is not supported ({place}): choose a folder on the disk of the workstation.
FICHIER_LIENS_PHYSIQUES: The data file has several names (hard links): make a plain copy of it on the disk of the workstation.
MIGRATION_SANS_SAUVEGARDE: The backup before the update failed ({failure}): the data file was not updated and the application stops. Check the free space and the rights of the backup folder.
MODE_SERVEUR_SQLITE: The server mode requires SQL Server: SQLite is allowed in the desktop mode only.
PARAMETRES_INVALIDES: The settings file settings.json is not valid ({property}): correct it or delete it.
RESTAURATION_SAUVEGARDE_ABSENTE: The chosen backup no longer exists.
RESTAURATION_SAUVEGARDE_CORROMPUE: The chosen backup is damaged: choose another one.
RESTAURATION_SAUVEGARDE_REFUSEE: The chosen backup cannot serve this version of the application (newer, with no known update, or changed): choose another one.
RESTAURATION_FICHIER_OUVERT: The data file is still open in another program: close it, then start again.
RESTAURATION_CHEMIN_NON_PRIS_EN_CHARGE: The path of the backup or of the data file is not supported: choose a folder on the disk of the workstation.
RESTAURATION_IMPOSSIBLE: The restore failed: the data file was left as it was.
QUITTER: Close this window to quit the application.
DEJA_LANCEE_OUVERTE: The application is already running: it opens in the browser.
REOUVERTE: A second start: the browser opens on the application.
RESTAURATION_PROPOSEE: Backups available, from the newest to the oldest. The changes made after the chosen backup are not in it; the current file and its journal will be kept next to it, not erased:
RESTAURATION_QUESTION: Number of the backup to restore (Enter to restore nothing):
DOSSIER_DONNEES_EXPOSE: Warning: the folder of the data file ({folder}) is readable by the other accounts of this machine. The place by default, in the profile of the user, is recommended.
DOSSIER_SAUVEGARDES_EXPOSE: Warning: the folder of the backups ({folder}) is readable by the other accounts of this machine. The place by default, in the profile of the user, is recommended.
COMMANDES_MULTIPLES: One command at a time: --migrate, --check, --export or --import.
MIGRATE_MODE_POSTE: --migrate serves the server mode only: in desktop mode, the data file is migrated when the application starts, after its backup.
MIGRATION_INUTILE: The database is already up to date: nothing was changed.
VERIFICATION_REUSSIE: Check passed: the configuration and the database can be used by this version.
VERIFICATION_FICHIER_A_CREER: Check passed: the data file does not exist yet, it will be created at the first start.
VERIFICATION_FICHIER_A_MIGRER: Check passed: the data file will be migrated at the next start, after its backup ({count} update(s)).
VERIFICATION_FICHIER_OUVERT: The data file is open in the application or in another program: close the application, then run --check again.
RESTAURATION_FICHIER_GARDE: The replaced file and its journal are kept next to the data file under the name {file}.
HOTES_AUTORISES_INVALIDES: The server mode requires the list of the names of the server, without "*" (setting Server:AllowedHosts): fill it in the configuration.
DELAI_MIGRATIONS_INVALIDE: The delay of the migrations must be from 1 to 1440 minutes (setting Database:MigrationTimeoutMinutes): correct it in the configuration.
INSTANCE_DEJA_LANCEE: The application already runs on this data file: use the window already open.
CHAINE_CONNEXION_ABSENTE: The server mode requires the connection string of SQL Server (setting Database:ConnectionString): fill it in the configuration.
SERVEUR_BASE_PLUS_RECENTE: The database was updated by a newer version of the application ({migration}). Install that version on the server.
SERVEUR_MIGRATION_MODIFIEE: The database does not match this version of the application (update {migration} changed). Restore the database, or install the version that updated it.
SERVEUR_SCHEMA_MODIFIE: The structure of the database was changed outside the application. Restore the database.
SERVEUR_EMPREINTE_ABSENTE: The database holds an update applied without the application ({migration}). Restore the database.
SERVEUR_DROITS_INSUFFISANTS: The account that connects lacks the rights it needs on the database: to run the application it must be a member of the role of the application in the database; for --migrate, a member of db_owner.
SERVEUR_CONNEXION_REFUSEE: SQL Server refuses the connection of this account: an account allowed on the instance is needed.
SERVEUR_BASE_INACCESSIBLE: The database does not exist, or the account cannot open it: create it by running the application with --migrate, or give the account a user in the database.
USAGE_EXPORT: Form of the command: --export <project code> <package file> --with-people or --without-people (say whether the package carries the members and the authors).
USAGE_IMPORT: Form of the command: --import <package file> --with-members or --without-members, and --code <CODE> if the code of the package is already taken.
COMMANDE_FICHIER_ABSENT: The data file does not exist yet: start the application once to create it.
COMMANDE_FICHIER_OUVERT: The data file is open in the application or in another program: close the application, then run the command again.
COMMANDE_FICHIER_A_MIGRER: The data file must be updated: start the application once (it backs it up, then updates it), then run the command again.
EXPORT_FICHIER_EXISTANT: The file {file} already exists: choose another name, the export never overwrites a file.
